issues.span: 世尊、如來、阿羅漢、正等覺者，佛以
issues.evidence: Tibetan བཅོམ་ལྡན་འདས་ is the vocative; the agent (ཀྱིས) is the single phrase དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ་དགྲ་བཅོམ་པ་ཡང་དག་པར་རྫོགས་པའི་སངས་རྒྱས (Skt tathāgatenārhatā samyaksaṃbuddhena). The translation lists 世尊 and the three epithets as one string of vocatives and then introduces a separate agent 佛, duplicating སངས་རྒྱས (already inside 正等覺者) and obscuring who benefited the bodhisattvas.
issues.fix: 世尊，如來、阿羅漢、正等覺者以所有最勝的饒益來饒益諸菩薩摩訶薩

issues.evidence: Tibetan ends ...ཚད་གཟུང་བར་སླ་བ་མ་ཡིན་པའི་ཕྱིར་རོ (the final ཕྱིར་རོ marks a reason clause: "it is because ... not easy to measure"); english_academic renders "it is because". The translation ends with a bare statement 不易衡量 and drops the causal marker (Sanskrit has no explicit "because", so the loss is slight).
issues.fix: ，須菩提，是因為其福德聚不易衡量

issues.evidence: Tibetan ends ...འཇུག་པར་མི་འགྱུར་བའི་ཕྱིར་རོ, i.e. the three non-perceptions are the stated reason ("because they have no perception of a sentient being ... "). 故如此 ("therefore it is so") is a vague, awkward rendering of ཕྱིར་རོ.
issues.fix: 因為他們無眾生想，無壽者想，亦不會生起人想。

issues.evidence: Tibetan འཕགས་པའི་གང་ཟག་རྣམས་ (locked 聖者); རྣམས is only a plural marker. 眾人 ("the crowd of people") is an unneeded addition and also doubles 人/གང་ཟག.
ཆོས་ཀྱི་རྣམ་གྲངས་ ("Dharma discourse") is a single locked term rendered 法門; the translation splits it into 教法 + 法門, giving the redundant "教法之法門".
ཡང་དག་པར་རྫོགས་པའི་སངས་རྒྱས་ (locked 正等覺者) already contains སངས་རྒྱས; the added 諸佛 renders it a second time as if a fourth epithet.
issues.fix: 諸位如來、阿羅漢、正等覺者的阿耨多羅三藐三菩提

issues.span: 正等覺者諸佛宣說我是
issues.evidence: The agent is singular: དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ་དགྲ་བཅོམ་པ་ཡང་དག་པར་རྫོགས་པའི་སངས་རྒྱས་ཀྱིས (no རྣམས་; Skt sg.; 7-30 "དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པས"). 諸佛 makes the declaring agent plural (all Buddhas) and doubles སངས་རྒྱས, already part of 正等覺者.
issues.fix: 如來、阿羅漢、正等覺者宣說我是住於無煩惱者之中的第一

issues.span: 遠離貪欲的離欲阿羅漢
issues.evidence: Tibetan འདོད་ཆགས་དང་བྲལ་བ་དགྲ་བཅོམ་པ ("an arhat free from desire") has one qualifier; 遠離貪欲 and 離欲 render it twice (tautology).

issues.span: 如來對我宣說：「善男子須菩提是住於無煩惱者之中的第一」
issues.evidence: Sanskrit: sacen mama ... na māṃ tathāgato vyākariṣyad araṇāvihāriṇām agryaḥ ... ("if I thought ..., the Tathāgata would NOT have declared me ..."); the Tibetan verb is the negated ལུང་མི་སྟོན་ལགས་སོ in 7-31 (commentary bo-chone-drakpa-shedrub 2-50: "ལུང་ མི་སྟོན"). The translation supplies a positive main verb 宣說 after the "if I thought" clause, so the conditional reads "if I thought I had attained arhatship, the Tathāgata declares me foremost", the opposite of the sense; english_academic has "would not declare".
issues.fix: 則如來不會對我宣說：「善男子須菩提是住於無煩惱者之中的第一」

issues.evidence: ཡང་དག་པར་རྫོགས་པའི་སངས་རྒྱས (locked 正等覺者) already includes སངས་རྒྱས; 這尊佛 is an added doubling and a demonstrative absent from the Tibetan.
ཆོས་ཀྱི་རྣམ་གྲངས་འདི་ is the single locked term 法門; splitting it as 教法的法門 is redundant.
ཆོས་ཀྱི་རྣམ་གྲངས་ (locked 法門) is split into 教法 + 法門, redundant.
ཆོས་ཀྱི་རྣམ་གྲངས་ (locked 法門) is split into 教法 + 法門, redundant.
